title: Reduction Exposure Load — Group Room Blocks Interim Deposit
content:
The reduction exposure load of a Group Room Blocks interim deposit follows how far signed reductions have already shrunk the contract, counted as the room nights of the block's reduction entries against the room nights of its allocation entry. The load is added to the interim percentage:

- reduction entries' room nights **at least 15 percent** of the allocation: a load of **5** percentage points;
- **at least 5 percent but below 15 percent**: a load of **2.5** percentage points;
- **below 5 percent**: no load.

### Questions the rule answers

**Which room nights are compared?** The total room nights of all reduction entries on the block ledger, against the room nights of the block's allocation entry, which are the room nights contracted at signing.

**Do increases on the block enter the comparison?** No. Only the reduction entries and the allocation entry are read.

**What if the block has no reduction entry?** Its reductions are 0 percent of the allocation, below 5 percent: no load.

### Worked comparisons (hypothetical allocation entry of 200 room nights)

| Reduction entries' room nights | Share of the allocation | Load |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 15 percent | 5 points |
| 29 | 14.5 percent | 2.5 points |
| 10 | 5 percent | 2.5 points |
| 9 | 4.5 percent | none |
